notes: As of 2026-10-25: boots the retail USA XBE, runs the title's own main loop, plays the attract video and streams the menu BGM. With a physical gamepad (RECOMP_USB=1), repeated maintainer runs reach New Game, save creation and loading, the main menu, the start-game stage and the pause menu. On the start-game stage the player's 3D model is drawn, but the stage world is not: only bamboo is visible. Next: stage world rendering. A black screen after New Game was seen in two runs on 2026-10-24, neither with RECOMP_AC97_READY=1; later runs with it did not show it. The cause is not established. Static recompilation with a pinned xboxrecomp submodule; no emulator and no CPU interpreter. The DSP is a passthrough stub, so audio effects are absent. The MinGW-w64 Windows cross-build is verified to link and reach the display-mode call under Wine; the MSVC 2022 path has never been run. Needs your own legally obtained USA Xbox disc; no game data is included.
